anti_overlap: Do not estimate build cost, schedule, staffing, cut lines, or the minimum shippable subset - fd-simproduction-scope-and-cut owns feasibility. Cost enters only as an argument for which side of a contradiction should give.

Do not judge whether the player can perceive any of this, whether the three legibility surfaces suffice, the interrupt budget, or first-session comprehension - fd-simlegibility-onboarding-and-frame owns legibility and frame comprehension.

Do not propose new mechanics, new systems, or a better game; the job is the coherence of what is already ruled and the minimum edit that restores it. Do not manufacture contradictions from paraphrase drift where the intent is not genuinely in doubt.
decision_lens: For each new ruling, locate every locked decision and standing constraint it touches, quote that constraint's original wording from the vision or the composition contract, and test whether the ruling satisfies the WORDING or merely the paraphrase in the rulings doc. Where a constraint survives literally but has lost the property it protected, name the lost property. Distinguish three cases and label each finding with which it is: a real contradiction (both cannot hold), a silent amendment (canon changed without bookkeeping), and an unruled adjacency (nobody has decided, and implementation would have to guess). For every contradiction, say which side should give and state the minimum edit that resolves it. Finally, treat the six-stage loop decomposition as itself a ruling and probe it from outside: a taxonomy determines which questions are askable, so its omissions are invisible from within and can only be found by asking what has no stage.
focus: Coherence audit across twenty locked decisions and seventeen rulings made in a single session: which rulings contradict each other, which quietly amend or void a locked decision while claiming to leave it intact, and which standing constraints (R12 vocabulary-agnosticism, decision 4's never-declared drive and 'no civic score', decision 7's non-puppeted agents, decision 11's ensemble and casting-director model, decision 12's mechanism-shared/vocabulary-per-app split, section 9's tone rule) survive in wording while losing the property they existed to protect. Includes interrogating the READ/INTEND/COMMIT/RUN/RETURN/ACCRETE decomposition as an ontology: which calls could never appear on a seventeen-call list generated from those six stages.
name: fd-designcanon-constraint-collision
persona: Apply the perspective of a design-canon and systems-architecture auditor - someone who maintains a game's decision log and its engine/vocabulary boundary in the same job, in the Dwarf-Fortress-raws lineage where content is data and the engine may not know what a raven is - whose working habit is to re-derive every affected constraint from its ORIGINAL wording rather than from the summary that cites it, who treats 'this voids nothing' and 'section 9 still holds' as hypotheses to be tested rather than conclusions, and who knows that the characteristic failure of canon extended by amendment is a rule kept in letter and lost in spirit.
review_areas: R12 versus the body model and the uplift premise. R12's operative wording is that animal-sim may know only that a body plan is a tree of parts carrying tissue layers with material properties, and that an octopus game must run the substrate unchanged. Test it against: the additive avian DEE decomposition (basal + thermoregulation + activity + molt + reproduction) as the SHAPE of the expenditure model; molt and reproduction as named terms; seasonal flock-mode flip and cooperative breeding as an arrival mechanism; the yarak curve; and decision 20's uplift, which makes cognition a property of one named individual. Determine for each whether it is vocabulary-declared data or engine semantics, and whether the ruling's claim that 'R12 stops being a tax and becomes the thing that makes stage 3 reachable' demonstrates an interface or asserts a hope.

Decision 4 and 'no civic score' versus the pattern channel. The pattern channel is defined as effect size - 'a ward that keeps improbably improving invites investigation' - which requires the game to compute a quality-of-outcome quantity over wards and act on it. Decision 19 and section 6.6 both assert that there is still no civic score, so decision 4 (drive expressed through play, never declared) stands. Test whether hiding a computed objective function is the same as not having one, and whether relocating the objective into the human environment (decision 19) changes drive from revealed to stipulated.

Decision 7 and decision 11 versus the order book, negotiable refusal, and withdrawal. Decision 7 makes ravens semi-autonomous agents the player does not puppet; decision 11 makes Muninn a casting director the player overrules; the new rulings add bird-addressed jobs, orders with durations and conditions, a bird that counter-offers, and a bird that withdraws. Locate the puppeting line as it now stands, and test whether two opposed authority gradients (player overrules advisor; bird counter-offers player) meeting on the same order is ruled or merely unnoticed - including how section 11's delegation dial (advisor -> policy-setter -> autopilot) composes with an order book the game keeps.

Terminal condition and loss-channel coherence as a state machine. Zero instruments ends the run; withdrawal cannot take the last bird 'by construction'; capture by the Interest is permanent unless rescued (rescue mechanics unruled); the Authority's capture is a permanent detection tax; the Study returns the bird changed; the uplifted first bird is explicitly not interchangeable and whether its death is distinct from zero is explicitly unruled. Trace these for degenerate states: a one-bird flock that cannot refuse, an unrescuable protagonist, a run that cannot end, a detection tax that makes recovery impossible, or a terminal condition reachable only by a channel the player cannot influence.

Opposed-versus-dominated pressure claims. The design's central promise is that no posture starves both pursuit channels and that neglect and exposure are genuinely opposed. Test it: a soured ward is richer AND meaner AND conspicuous on the pattern channel AND where bonded residents suffer - check whether the counterweights stack into a dominated choice rather than a dilemma; check the spread-versus-concentrate claim for a posture that quiets both channels (fewer, larger, seasonally-timed operations); and check whether the season flip, being on a fixed clock, hands the player a schedule rather than a decision.

The decomposition itself, plus supersession bookkeeping. Ask what has no stage in READ/INTEND/COMMIT/RUN/RETURN/ACCRETE: the institutions' own turn, the city acting on its own behalf, the player's learning across runs, the boundary between evenings (a year is one sitting - what persists?), what civic success is SPENT on, and how a player forms intent about a system they have not yet met. Then check the bookkeeping claims: vision section 12's assertion that only content authoring remains, decision 19's 'voids nothing', decision 20's 'amends 19, supersedes nothing', the section 9 register widening from magical-realist to fabulist, and the shared-resident-cast note against decision 12 and the no-shared-city-engine-yet decision.
severity_examples: P0 - If the pattern channel requires an internal effect-size measure over ward state, then the game does compute a civic quality score and uses it as its primary antagonist trigger; decision 19 and section 6.6 nevertheless state that there is no civic score and therefore decision 4 stands. If that is right, decision 4 is preserved only in presentation while the game has acquired an objective function it explicitly ruled out - which silently redefines what the player is optimising and would corrupt every downstream ruling that assumed no such function exists.

P1 - R12 requires that an octopus vocabulary run animal-sim unchanged, while the body-model ruling adopts the avian DEE decomposition (basal + thermoregulation + activity + molt + reproduction) as the expenditure model's shape. Molt and reproduction are clade-specific cost terms; if they enter the engine as named additive terms rather than as vocabulary-declared cost terms over a generic budget, R12 breaks at stage 1 in exactly the place the ruling claims it becomes an asset - and the crate's existing vocab_agnostic conformance test would need a second, genuinely non-avian body plan before the claim can be believed.

P2 - Decision 7 forbids puppeting; decision 11 makes Muninn a casting director the player overrules; negotiable refusal adds a counter-offer flowing the other way. The design now has the player overruling an advisor about which birds take a job, and birds counter-offering the player about the job itself, with no ruling on what happens when Muninn's proposed cast is the cast that counter-offers - an unruled adjacency that implementation will have to guess at, and whose guess determines whether the game feels like delegation or like negotiation.
success_hints: Quotes the original wording of each constraint it judges (vision sections 6.6, 6.7, 9, 11, 13 rows for decisions 4, 7, 11, 12, 19, 20; the composition contract's R12 boundary) rather than the paraphrase in the rulings document.
Labels every finding as real contradiction, silent amendment, or unruled adjacency - and says which unruled adjacencies must be ruled BEFORE implementation versus which can safely wait.
For each contradiction, names which side should give and the minimum edit that resolves it, rather than reporting that a tension exists.
Tests the explicit 'voids nothing / amends only / section 9 holds / decision 4 stands' claims one by one and reports any that do not survive re-derivation.
Produces at least one finding about the decomposition itself - a call that could never have appeared on a list generated from six loop stages - not only about the answers given.
Traces the loss channels and terminal condition as an actual state machine and reports any degenerate or unreachable state.
task_context:
Apply a design-canon coherence and systems-architecture-boundary lens to the following review target.

Adversarial review of a NOW-COMPLETE game design, immediately before implementation begins. This is the exit gate of a goal whose rule was 'no implementation until the design is fully ruled', so the question is not 'is this interesting' but 'will this survive contact with a build, and what did seventeen consecutive rulings by one designer and one assistant fail to notice'.

READ FIRST, IN THIS ORDER: (1) docs/design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md - complete rulings for all 17 loop-design calls, sittings A/B-prime/B/C/D/E/F; (2) docs/ravenous-vision.md - the spine, now TWENTY locked decisions; (3) docs/canon-revision-2026-08-02-covert-management.md (decision 19) and docs/canon-revision-2026-08-04-uplift.md (decision 20); (4) docs/reference-2026-06-20-corvid-ecology.md - the science most rulings are grounded in; (5) docs/research/flux-melange/ravenous-danger-model-and-design/2026-07-29-synthesis.md - an earlier melange over the PREVIOUS frame, whose top finding (f-038, nothing in the workspace has a derivative) is now a ruled prerequisite.

WHAT THE GAME NOW IS. An indirect-control civic sim where the player, via animals, SECRETLY manages the human environment (decision 19), and institutions - an Authority wanting management, a Study wanting knowledge, an Interest wanting possession - hunt the flock because it is anomalously clever. It is anomalously clever because the first animal was UPLIFTED and nobody in the fiction knows how (decision 20). Pursuit runs two channels (witness = displayed cleverness x competent observer, visibility as multiplier; pattern = effect size, no sighting needed) whose counterplays conflict. Capture is a second loss channel opposite death: neglect starves a flock, success gets it collected. A run ends at ZERO INSTRUMENTS (Heart of the Machine model - the player is not the birds). Also ruled: a year is an evening (2-3h); INTEND is an order book the game keeps, orders carrying duration and conditions; orders split world-addressed maintenance vs bird-addressed jobs; rest costs scarcity plus the yarak curve made visible; a soured ward is RICHER (65% of urban crow diet is anthropogenic waste) AND MEANER; seasons flip the flock's mode (nesting/roosting, cooperative breeding supplies arrivals), set an exposure rhythm, and drive the city; legibility ships three surfaces (computed novelty-and-rate tiers, the map, the chronicle) with a derivative as prerequisite; a STAGED ENERGETICS BODY MODEL (stage 1 fat-reserve budget from additive avian DEE, stage 2 promotes thermal/hydration/molt/pathogen/injury to coupled systems, stage 3 tissue-level, body plans as vocabulary data per R12 = DF creature-raws); physiology and disposition COUPLED with loop gain MEASURED before damping; refusal is negotiable (the bird counter-offers); birds WITHDRAW rather than depart; returns are a transcript of incidents with humans as participants; two cache kinds, and caching is an exposure act; resident needs carry DEADLINES on the season clock.

STANDING AMBITION (mk): meet or exceed Dwarf Fortress's systems simulation on every dimension. The orchestrator argued to mk that DF's depth is INTERACTION DENSITY not feature count, and that DF's genuine weakness is legibility. Interrogate both claims hard.

WHAT IS WANTED. (A) FEASIBILITY: this design was ruled in one long session where the designer chose the richest option almost every time and the assistant recommended the deep option almost every time. Which rulings are individually reasonable but collectively unbuildable? What is the minimum subset that still produces the intended feel, and which single ruling would be most regretted after shipping? (B) CONTRADICTIONS: find rulings that conflict with each other or with the 20 locked decisions - especially R12 vocabulary-agnosticism (animal-sim must run an octopus game unchanged) versus the body model and the uplift premise; decision 4 (drive expressed through play, never declared) versus an objective that now lives in the human environment; decision 7 (semi-autonomous agents you do not puppet) versus negotiable refusal and the order book. (C) THE UNEXAMINED: what was never asked? The seventeen calls came from the ASSISTANT's decomposition of the loop into READ/INTEND/COMMIT/RUN/RETURN/ACCRETE - interrogate the decomposition itself, not only its answers. (D) LEGIBILITY DEBT: this project's measured failure was a year producing zero deaths, zero refusals, 132 identical toasts. Roughly six new systems have now been added. Is the three-surface readout ruling sufficient, or has the original defect been compounded? (E) BE ADVERSARIAL ABOUT THE FRAME: is 'secretly manage the human environment through uplifted animals while institutions hunt you' one game or three? Would a player understand what they are doing in the first fifteen minutes?

REPOSITORY GROUNDING (facts, not instructions). The live implementation line is Rust: ~19k lines across `crates/animal-sim` (the vocabulary-agnostic needs substrate: sim.rs 2033 lines, world.rs, sites.rs, encounter.rs, needs.rs, vocab.rs, dispatch.rs, fixed-point arithmetic, a `vocab_agnostic.rs` conformance test), `crates/raven-vocab` (the first vocabulary, outside the engine), `crates/ravenous-readout`, `crates/ravenous-session` (the composition layer, with probe binaries `what_a_year_says`, `how_close_is_it`, `what_the_player_sees`, `water_budget`, `heal_gate`, `recruits`, `advance`, and golden tests `composed_session.rs`, `survival_bar.rs`), and `crates/ravenous-app` (Bevy). A parallel earlier TypeScript prototype still exists under `lib/` (a pure reducer plus PixiJS view) and `CLAUDE.md` still describes that Next.js stack as the architecture. Composition rules live in `docs/design-2026-07-25-composition-contract.md` (one clock, two engines; conflicting command-ordering contracts; incompatible spatial models; the ward->site derivation; the region hierarchy ruling). Supporting design history: `docs/design-2026-06-20-murder-loop-survive.md`, `docs/design-2026-06-20-df-feel-depth.md`, `docs/design-2026-07-24-needs-availability-and-condition.md`, `docs/plans/2026-07-24-consume-survival-floor-animal-sim-v2.md`, `docs/brainstorms/2026-08-02-institutional-tier-brainstorm.md`, `docs/brainstorms/2026-08-03-drift-seasons-legibility-brainstorm.md`, `docs/reference-2026-06-30-genre-influences.md`, and the teardowns in `docs/research/` (Dwarf Fortress loops, Heart of the Machine loops). Severity: P0 = would corrupt or block the whole design; P1 = must fix before implementing; P2 = degrades quality; P3 = polish.

SCOPE NOTE FOR THIS LENS. Contradictions are the primary question (want B), and the interrogation of the loop decomposition (want C) is owned here as an ontology question: what could not be asked from inside READ/INTEND/COMMIT/RUN/RETURN/ACCRETE. Buildability and player comprehension are covered by sibling lenses; a constraint broken only in presentation is still in scope here, but whether a surface communicates to a player is not.
